boundary.description: From the Junction of Buxton Lane and Manchester Road, E along Manchester Road, Ashton Road, Droylsden Road, Park Road, Slate Lane and by a bee-line to Groby Road North, then S, and SW by Audenshaw Road, King’s Road, Green Fold (going between Gorton Lower and Upper Reservoir). Then along N boundary of Gorton Lower Reservoir to its NW corner and by a bee-line, crossing Abbey Hey Lane to the railway. W by the tracks to Gorton station and N by Lees Street, Ettrick Close, Wheler Street, Edge Lane, to its crossing with Ashton Canal. E along the canal to the point opposite Buxton Lane, then N by Buxton Lane to its junction with Manchester Road.
